about.title: About
about.introNamed: I'm {name}, an independent web designer and developer.
about.text: Every project starts in writing: what will be built and why. Then it is designed and coded with testing, accessibility and speed from the start. This site is the proof: it reads without JavaScript, works with the keyboard and respects accessibility for every user.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: One message is enough to start: what is needed, by when and a rough budget.
contact.form.label: Contact form
contact.form.name: Name
contact.form.privacy: The message is stored in Supabase and delivered by email through Resend; it is only used to reply. Cloudflare Turnstile checks that it is not spam.
contact.form.noscript: The form needs JavaScript. WhatsApp and email work just the same without it.
contact.form.fallbackError: The message could not be sent. Try again, or write via WhatsApp or email.
contact.form.error.email: The email is not valid: it should look like name@domain.com.
contact.form.alert.verification: The spam check could not be completed. Sending again will retry it.
contact.form.alert.rate_limit: Too many messages in a row. Another one can be sent in a few minutes.
contact.form.alert.too_large: The message is too long to send.
contact.form.alert.server: The message could not be sent because of a server error. Try again, or write via WhatsApp or email.
contact.form.alert.network: Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.
thanks.title: Message sent
thanks.text: Thanks for writing. The reply will go to the email given in the form.
notFound.title: This page does not exist
